data.summary_en: DeltaTTG adds shared progress meter to multi-turn agent training, supervising Token-to-Go (tokens remaining before task completion); actor training reallocates outcome advantages by progress estimates without changing rewards. On ALFWorld, PaperSearchQA, and BFCLv3, average scores exceed GRPO by 5.7 and 7.2 points on Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.
